title: The Uncharted Provision
premise: Ivo Zhou has spent years erasing herself from her famous archaeologist father's shadow, digging contract sites under false names to pay off a debt she never explains. When his expedition upriver goes silent, she takes the only boat available—a leaking wreck crewed by Tamás Reyes, a disgraced river pilot who asks no questions—and heads into the monsoon. What they find is not rescue but betrayal: her father sold the dig's artifacts to fund his disappearance, and the debt collectors Ivo fled are his creditors too. In the flooded ruins where the expedition made its last stand, Ivo must choose between salvaging her father's legacy and saving the people the river is about to swallow; she chooses the living, burns the manifest that could clear her name, and returns downstream owning nothing but the compass—and, for the first time, belonging to someone.
about_author: Orsen Crane is the pen name of a former river freight dispatcher who spent six seasons on monsoon waterways before turning to fiction. They write adventure novels about people whose survival depends on strangers.

chapters.title: The Debt in the Dirt
chapters.summary: Ivo Zhou, working a salvage dig under a borrowed name, is recognized by a collector's agent who knows her father's face in hers. She flees with her compass and a warning: the debt follows bloodlines. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: the exhaustion of a life built on invisibility beginning to crack.

chapters.title: Radio Silence
chapters.summary: A forwarded message reveals her father's upriver expedition missed three scheduled check-ins. The university wants a family member; Ivo wants nothing to do with him, but the agent's men are closing in, and the river is the only way out. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: resentment weaponized into reluctant purpose.

chapters.title: A Boat Named Regret
chapters.summary: Ivo hires Tamás Reyes, a pilot barred from legitimate runs after a disaster he won't discuss, and his patched, leaking boat. Their first night on the water establishes an uneasy truce: he doesn't ask about the compass, she doesn't ask about the ban. POV: alternating Ivo and Tamás. Emotional beat: two guarded people recognizing each other's damage.

chapters.title: What the River Keeps
chapters.summary: They pass drowned villages and abandoned dredges, finding evidence another boat went upstream ahead of them—armed men flying the collector's flag. Tamás patches the hull with canvas and prayer while Ivo deciphers her father's last radio coordinates. POV: Tamás. Emotional beat: dawning dread that they're being followed.

chapters.title: Monsoon Warning
chapters.summary: Storm clouds stack on the horizon as the engine fails. Ivo dives into silted shallows to free the fouled propeller, nearly drowning, and surfaces changed—she admits aloud why she digs under false names. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: vulnerability offered and, unexpectedly, received.

chapters.title: The Camp That Stopped Answering
chapters.summary: They reach the expedition camp: tents shredded, radios smashed, and a ledger proving her father traded artifacts to the collectors to buy passage out of his debts. One survivor, a young surveyor named Bea, hides in a cistern. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: grief curdling into fury at the father who was never who she needed.

chapters.title: Buyers and Liars
chapters.summary: The armed boat arrives. Its captain offers Ivo a deal: the manifest clearing her name in exchange for leading him to the vault where the best pieces were hidden. She recognizes the vault's location from childhood stories—her father's real legacy, buried beneath the flood line. POV: Tamás. Emotional beat: temptation wearing a familiar face.

chapters.title: High Water
chapters.summary: The monsoon makes landfall early. As the river swallows the lower camp, Ivo leads the captain's men to the vault—but it floods as they open it, drowning the artifacts' value and nearly the men. In the chaos she, Tamás, and Bea escape downriver through rapids no sane pilot would run. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: the climax—choosing lives over legacy, at last.

chapters.title: What Burns
chapters.summary: Stranded on a temple rise above the flood, Ivo burns the recovered manifest pages rather than trade them for her own exoneration, severing her father's hold on her forever. Tamás finally tells her about the disaster that broke him, and she tells him the truth of her debt. POV: Tamás. Emotional beat: mutual absolution; identity rebuilt from choice, not inheritance.

chapters.title: Downstream
chapters.summary: Weeks later, the three deliver Bea home and face the consequences together—Ivo under her real name for the first time in years. The collectors' claim dies with the drowned evidence; her father's fate remains the river's secret. Ivo signs on as Tamás's partner for the next season's runs. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: quiet resolution—belonging earned, not inherited.
